entries.en: Added support for Microsoft Foundry! See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/azure-ai-foundry
entries.zh: 添加了对 Microsoft Foundry 的支持！请参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/azure-ai-foundry

entries.en: Added `PermissionRequest` hook to automatically approve or deny tool permission requests with custom logic
entries.zh: 添加了`PermissionRequest`挂钩，以使用自定义逻辑自动批准或拒绝工具权限请求

entries.en: Send background tasks to Claude Code on the web by starting a message with `&`
entries.zh: 在消息开头输入 `&`，即可把后台任务发送到 Claude Code on the web
